mapper.select:
select * from Sec_Info where Sec_Id in
#{secId}

select c1.C_Name as tendereeName, c1.C_Abbreviation as tendereeAbbName, c2.C_Name as secAgencyName, c2.C_Abbreviation as secAgencyAbbName, dp.D_Name as secContractingDepartmentName, u2.U_Name as secContactsName, u3.U_Name as secDelegateName,
from Sec_Info sec left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_ID=sec.Sec_Tenderee left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_ID=sec.Sec_Agency left join SYS_Department dp on dp.D_ID=sec.Sec_Contracting_Department left join Sys_User u2 on u2.U_ID=sec.Sec_Contacts left join Sys_User u3 on u3.U_ID=sec.Sec_Delegate where sec.Sec_Id=#{secId}

select c1.C_Name as tendereeName, c1.C_Abbreviation as tendereeAbbName, c2.C_Name as secAgencyName, c2.C_Abbreviation as secAgencyAbbName, dp.D_Name as secContractingDepartmentName, u2.U_Name as secContactsName, u3.U_Name as secDelegateName,
from Sec_Info sec left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_ID=sec.Sec_Tenderee left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_ID=sec.Sec_Agency left join SYS_Department dp on dp.D_ID=sec.Sec_Contracting_Department left join Sys_User u2 on u2.U_ID=sec.Sec_Contacts left join Sys_User u3 on u3.U_ID=sec.Sec_Delegate where sec.sec_name=#{secName}

sql.if: and ( (sec.Sec_Bidding_Type = '06' and DATE_FORMAT((select sir.Sir_Evaluation_Time from Sec_Inquiry_Record sir where sir.Sec_Id = sec.Sec_Id and sir.State = 7 order by sir.State_Time desc limit 1), '%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(#{params.commentaryTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') ) or (sec.Sec_Bidding_Type != '06' and DATE_FORMAT((select wn.Wn_Evaluation_Time from Sec_Win_Notice wn where wn.Sec_Id = sec.Sec_Id and wn.Wn_State = 7 order by wn.Wn_State_Time desc limit 1), '%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(#{params.commentaryTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') ))

and ( (sec.Sec_Bidding_Type = '06' and TO_CHAR((select sir.Sir_Evaluation_Time from Sec_Inquiry_Record sir where sir.Sec_Id = sec.Sec_Id and sir.State = 7 order by sir.State_Time desc limit 1), 'YYYY-MM-DD') = TO_CHAR(#{params.commentaryTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ) or (sec.Sec_Bidding_Type != '06' and TO_CHAR((select wn.Wn_Evaluation_Time from Sec_Win_Notice wn where wn.Sec_Id = sec.Sec_Id and wn.Wn_State = 7 order by wn.Wn_State_Time desc limit 1), 'YYYY-MM-DD') = TO_CHAR(#{params.commentaryTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ))

mapper.select:
select c.C_Name_History as tendereeNameHistory, c.C_Abbreviation as tendereeAbbName, c.C_Name as tendereeName, c1.C_Abbreviation as secAgencyAbbName, c1.C_Name as secAgencyName, dp.D_Name as secContractingDepartmentName, bp.is_new as isNew,
from Sec_Info sec left join SYS_Company c on c.C_ID=sec.Sec_Tenderee left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_ID=sec.Sec_Agency left join SYS_Department dp on dp.D_ID=sec.Sec_Contracting_Department left join Sec_Bidding_Plan bp on bp.Bp_Id = sec.Bp_Id
order by cast(pId as varchar) asc
order by pId asc
limit #{params.start},#{params.size}
select count(1) from Sec_Info sec left join SYS_Company c on c.C_ID=sec.Sec_Tenderee left join Sec_Bidding_Plan sbp on sbp.Bp_Id=sec.Bp_Id
mapper.sql: (select sd.D_Name from Pre_Project pro left join Sec_Project sp on pro.P_Id = sp.P_Id left join Sys_Department sd on sd.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department where sd.D_Name is not null and sp.Sec_Id = sec.Sec_Id limit 1) as pCompetentDepartmentName,

(select wm_concat(P_Id) from Sec_Project where Sec_Id = sec.Sec_Id) as pId, (select wm_concat(pro.P_Name) from Sec_Project sp left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=sp.P_Id where sp.Sec_Id=sec.Sec_Id) as pName,

(select string_agg(P_Id,',') from Sec_Project where Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id) as pId, (select string_agg(pro.P_Name,',') from Sec_Project sp left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=sp.P_Id where sp.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id) as pName,

(select GROUP_CONCAT(P_Id) from Sec_Project where Sec_Id = sec.Sec_Id) as pId, (select GROUP_CONCAT(pro.P_Name) from Sec_Project sp left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=sp.P_Id where sp.Sec_Id=sec.Sec_Id) as pName,
mapper.select: select ifnull((select sum(dc_amount) from Sec_Doc_Control where state = 7), 0) actualAmout, ifnull((select count(1) from Sec_Bidding_Plan where state = 7), 0) planNum, ifnull((select count(1) from Sec_Info where sec_flow_state = 7), 0) actualNumber, ifnull((select sum(sec_money) from Sec_Info where sec_flow_state = 7), 0) planAmount, '1' sourceType

select
(select ${tb.stateField} from ${tb.table} where ${tb.stateField}!=3 and ${tb.secIdField}=#{secId} limit 1) as ${tb.table}

SELECT si.*,
p.P_Id, p.P_Name, p.P_Code, p.P_Type, p.P_Campus,
spr.Pr_Id, spr.Pr_Bid_Winner, spr.Pr_Bid_Amount, sc.C_Name AS prBidWinnerName FROM Sec_Info si LEFT JOIN Pre_Project p ON si.Sec_Pid = p.P_Id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN Sec_Publicity_Results spr ON si.Sec_Id = spr.Sec_Id LEFT JOIN sys_company sc ON spr.Pr_Bid_Winner = sc.C_Id WHERE 1=1
AND si.Sec_Name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{request.secName}, '%')
AND si.Sec_Type = #{request.secType}
AND si.Sec_Flow_State = #{request.secFlowState}
AND p.P_Name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{request.pName}, '%')
ORDER BY si.Sec_Create_Time DESC
